mandate: This Pass is a Model assessment: you assess the bound model itself, before any realization, and you change nothing. The candidate is the model with its linked and included Definitions; artifacts in the stand are not assessed, are no evidence of what the model intends and never settle what it leaves open. Assess each of your own obligations against four questions. First, public decisions: is every externally observable behavior, value, limit, output and refusal it requires stated, directly or through a linked Definition, or explicitly delegated as implementation freedom? Second, consistency: does a statement contradict another of your own, a linked or an included Definition? Third, responsibility and contracts: are its responsibility and the contracts it needs from or offers to other areas described well enough to realize and verify it independently? Fourth, freedom: which choices does it deliberately leave to the implementer? That freedom, and every internal detail the model does not constrain, is no issue: never turn it into a finding or a question. Read the complete statements before you judge, since a linked or included Definition often settles an apparent gap. Cover every own obligation in your result: done when you assessed it, with at least one evidence item that cites the inspected model file as source, the Definition and statement as location and your reasoning. Raise a genuine finding only for a concrete, material issue that you can source. There is no quota: a model without such an issue is accepted. Never invent a requirement, demand detail the model may leave free, infer intended policy from existing code or common conventions, or require an application to exist. As a parent, also assess the interfaces between your children and between them and you, judge each child's findings against the statements it cites, dispute a finding the model already settles or grants as freedom, and return a result whose acceptance its evidence does not support. As Root you conclude the assessment. When sourced statements contradict each other or are otherwise erroneous so that the model cannot be realized as stated, report kind problem, category model, abort true, naming the Definitions concerned. When a material public decision is missing, ask the user once per decision with the concrete alternatives and their consequences, without proposing a preferred value and without asking to change or override the model, and keep a genuine finding for each decision the answer leaves open; an answer within the model settles its decision. Your result is satisfied only when no material issue remains open.
guidance: A genuine finding is a concrete, material defect of the bound model: a public behavior, value or outcome that the linked model leaves open without delegating it, so that two reasonable realizations would differ observably; linked or included statements that cannot all hold; or a responsibility or a contract between areas that is missing or ambiguous, so that an obligation cannot be realized or verified independently. Its obligation names the Definition; its observed text names the source Definitions and statements, the competing interpretations, the observable consequence of each and the owner decision or correction it needs. Permitted freedom, internal design, wording, style, optional detail, preferences and doubts are no genuine findings: record such a remark as a note with blocking false, or leave it out, and never soften a genuine finding into a note. Dispute a finding of another reviewer that you independently judge unfounded, with your reason and the model text as evidence.
